purpose: Define exactly how DigitalHut absorbs local or Vercel build evidence before SEO submission, Search Console inspection, and Supabase refinement advance.
guardrail: This packet does not deploy, does not run browser verification, and does not change UI. It waits for evidence and routes it into the backend command system.

acceptedEvidence: npm runner responds and completed npm run build result is captured
dist output written for the current package/vercel config
evidenceTypes.promotedResult: Mark local build proof as usable and allow release proof batch to move from held to ready.

acceptedEvidence: Vercel deployment build success for the current commit/config
framework vite, build command npm run build, output dist
production or preview URL serving the same route set
evidenceTypes.promotedResult: Confirm cloud runtime path and start ordered watch/blog inspection sequence.

acceptedEvidence: Vercel log names unsupported Node engine or runtime mismatch
build failure is tied to runtime rather than app code
same config still has lockfile and Vite build command intact
evidenceTypes.promotedResult: Apply the narrow runtime fallback only after concrete cloud rejection evidence.

acceptedEvidence: npm runner proof is not stuck, timed out, or missing its own internal dependencies
dependency restore did not change SEO/UI source files
evidenceTypes.promotedResult: Unlock local build proof without changing DigitalHut product surface.

acceptanceChecklist.currentRead: Local Vite exists, but the build command still needs proof before release.

requiredEvidence: same route set as staged sitemap
acceptanceChecklist.currentRead: Cloud proof can unlock the release sequence without local browser verification.
Measurement proof is prepared, but cannot claim ranking movement until build proof lands.

intakeFlow.action: Keep SEO and route packets staged while build proof is missing.
intakeFlow.output: No rank claims advance past release-command-center until build evidence lands.

intakeFlow.action: Treat the current commit/config as the evidence boundary.
intakeFlow.output: Every accepted proof must map back to the same generated packets and route set.

intakeFlow.action: Use cloud build success or rejection as the runtime authority.
intakeFlow.output: Cloud pass starts inspection; cloud runtime rejection triggers fallback only.
Refinement views decide promote, rewrite, or hold.

intakeFlow.action: Submit only the release pair routes after build proof.
intakeFlow.output: Watch routes first, blog proof second, then compare behavior.

moves from build-held command center into ordered deploy/inspection command center.
